gap.title: multiplicity laundering in the record parser (R79-C2)
gap.item: pointer-bind.py discovers its five checks by regex instead of enumerating them. parse_record builds pins = {name: (pin, pointer) for name, pin, pointer in RE_PIN.findall(text)}, a dict comprehension where a second cell for the same client silently overwrites the first (last wins); RE_GHIDRA_PTR and RE_BASHRC_PTR use .search(), so a stale quotation placed earlier in the record wins over the live cell. A record carrying more than five pointer cells still reports checks_total 5, matched 5, mismatches 0, unparsed 0 - the guard is cardinality over parsed results, not exhaustiveness over the record.

measured.conclusion: checks_total and unparsed are indistinguishable between a 5-cell and a 6-cell record

gap.sibling_pattern_that_catches_it: P1 tameshi pointer-recheck: each manifest row carries an explicit id and 'the exact cited token', and a row whose token is absent from the record bytes is refused, not passed (line 36) - multiplicity must be written down and each occurrence measures miss or ERROR. P4 closes the same hole by making the accepted set declarative and reporting everything outside it.
gap.falsifies_note: latent only; the live PROVINCE.md at the freeze parses exactly five cells with no duplicates

secondary_finding.title: unattributed kill (R79-C1)
secondary_finding.item: gate-mutation.py computes sole_detector and detector_count per mutant and never grades them: ok requires only len(mutants)==len(MUTANTS), survivors==0, pin.matched and pristine.ok, and validate_receipt ignores both fields. A mass-failure mutant (all 29 cases red) is judged killed=True with detector_count=29, sole_detector=False, and a receipt of eight such mutants validates with defects=[].
secondary_finding.sibling_pattern_that_catches_it: tameshi tools/shrink-case.py:11 - 'A kill is the round-49 generator's oracle read of the pair: check passes on the pristine guard and fails on the mutant', reduced to a fixpoint so the result is 1-minimal: removing any one unit loses the kill
secondary_finding.falsifies_note: latent; m03, m05 and m08 are sole in the landed receipt as the predicate states
secondary_finding.note: not the declared gap; same structural property as G1 - singularity of the evidence

mutation_adds: --rev: mutate the target at an arbitrary measured revision, not the clone's HEAD
target_pin.matched: declared 64-hex digest of the mutated file (P3 has none; P2 has only a restore proof)
absent declared case is a SURVIVOR counted against - stricter than P2 (INCONCLUSIVE bucket) and P3 (abort at exit 2)
per-case attribution: declared_case, failed_cases, detector_count, sole_detector (P2 grades suite exit only; P3 names one arm but records no detector count)
pristine 29 cases / 0 failures as a literal pass precondition
mutation_misses: no expected-red arm field (P1's pattern adapted)
pointer_adds: bespoke to a prose record: five named drift-prone cells each bound to a declared token
--control path-only reproduces the round-78 rule on the same stale record to show it cannot fail; neither sibling has a rule-reproduction control
line_sha256 of the pointed span instead of its bytes, matching kama tools/append-only-audit.py:176 (DHEADER = commit/file/line_sha256/count/class/note)
unparsed as a first-class failure plus checks_total==5, so a vanished cell fails rather than passing vacuously (same instinct as P1's zero-row guard)
pointer_misses: no expect field, so a known-stale pointer that cannot be repaired has no representable met state (P1 lines 41-44)
regex-discovered rather than manifest-enumerated cells; multiplicity collapses (G1)

validate_receipt re-derives counts only from the receipt's own checks list and never re-reads bytes; the lane's selftest enshrines green-forged-consistent, so a fabricated receipt with plausible digests validates with defects []
line_sha256 is tested only for truthiness, never 64-hex shape, unlike record.sha256 which is length-checked

targets read from the worktree while the record is read from git - forced, not a defect: the pointed targets are ambient host files outside any git object store, so P1's target_rev device cannot apply and line_sha256 is the only available pin
